quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-07-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Results for the six months ended September 30, 2025: net sales JPY 64,246 million (+7.2% YoY); operating profit JPY 956 million (-48.3%); ordinary profit JPY 779 million (+161.2%); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 269 million (+244.9%). Capacitor segment: sales JPY 61,873 million (+7.3%) on higher aluminum electrolytic capacitor demand in the ICT market, segment profit JPY 927 million (-44.7%) due to soaring raw-material prices. Other segment: sales JPY 2,372 million (+4.7%; lower CMOS camera module sales, higher inductor sales), segment profit JPY 29 million (-83.1%).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 64,246 million (+7.2%); operating profit JPY 956 million (-48.3%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-07-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's review of the first half (six months ended September 30, 2025): data-center investment by major US IT companies continued and demand for generative-AI servers and peripherals stayed firm, while automotive demand recovery slowed on US tariff policy and industrial equipment did not fully recover. The company focused on expanding sales for server demand including AI servers, which it expects to keep growing steadily on strong data-center investment, ended production of unprofitable products, increased production capacity for large aluminum electrolytic capacitors and hybrid capacitors, and built an optimal-location production setup using its ASEAN bases in response to US tariff policy. H1 R&D expenses were JPY 2,002 million; purchases of property, plant and equipment were JPY 3,107 million.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 2,002 million; PP&E purchases JPY 3,107 million
